name: actual-budget-mcp-es
description: Talk to your self-hosted Actual Budget: spending analysis, budget tracking, net worth and assisted writes.
long_description: An MCP server built for LLM consumption: transfers never pollute spending summaries, net worth includes off-budget accounts, amounts are converted server-side, and split transactions use real subtransactions. Write tools are opt-in and there are no delete tools. Requires a Mac with Apple Silicon.

server_url.title: Actual server URL
server_url.description: URL of your self-hosted Actual Budget server, e.g. https://actual.example.org/

password.title: Server password
password.description: The password you use to open Actual Budget in the browser

sync_id.title: Budget Sync ID
sync_id.description: In Actual: Settings → Advanced Settings → Sync ID

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Formats amounts, e.g. en-US or es-ES

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD or EUR

enable_write.title: Enable write tools
enable_write.description: Off: 8 read-only tools. On: 8 more that can edit transactions, splits, budgets and notes. Your MCP client asks for approval before each call unless you grant it standing permission.

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: Category groups and categories with their ids

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Search transactions by date, account, category, text or amount

tools.name: get_spending_summary
tools.description: Aggregated spending by category, payee or month

tools.name: get_budget_month
tools.description: Budget status for a month, per category

tools.name: get_budget_averages
tools.description: Average, median and max spending per category over N months

tools.name: update_transaction
tools.description: Edit a transaction's category, payee, notes, date or amount

tools.name: categorize_transactions
tools.description: Categorize up to 50 transactions in one call

tools.name: split_transaction
tools.description: Split a transaction into real subtransactions

tools.name: create_transaction
tools.description: Record a new expense or income, optionally already split

tools.name: create_schedule
tools.description: Create a recurring or one-off scheduled transaction

tools.name: set_budget
tools.description: Assign budget amounts to categories, single or bulk
